description: This file defines schemas for task API responses and requests in a software project, including serialization/deserialization logic, field descriptions, and API method overrides.

classes.name: UserSchema
classes.description: Schema for user information, including id, first_name, last_name.

classes.name: TaskResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for task response, including task details, status, timestamps, payload, properties, subscribers, and related methods.

classes.name: TaskStatusResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for lightweight task status response used for polling.

classes.name: TaskCancelRequestSchema
classes.description: Schema for task cancellation request, including a force boolean.

classes.name: TaskCancelResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for task cancellation response, including message, action, and task details.

methods.name: get_payload_dict
methods.description: Returns the payload as a dictionary.

methods.name: get_properties
methods.description: Returns properties dictionary, filtering out 'stack_trace' if SHOW_STACKTRACE is disabled.

methods.name: get_subscribers
methods.description: Returns list of subscribers with user info and subscription time.
